name: Langland Bay Manor
stayType: Apartment in a restored Victorian manor
parking: Private, secure off-road parking plus visitor parking
beachAccess: Langland Bay is described as on the doorstep
overview: This three-bedroom apartment is on the second floor of a restored, Grade II-listed Victorian manor above Langland Bay. It sleeps six, with three bathrooms, and has private off-road parking. It is booked through Original Cottages.
surfTripFit: You can walk to the beach and back to a car parked off-road, and three bathrooms help when a group comes in sandy.
